scope: Focused Field Collector consent, offline-shell, vault, media, API, and Gateway CORS regressions

python.command: KOKONUT_GATEWAY_AUDIT_SPOOL_PATH=<private-temporary-directory>/gateway-audit.sqlite3 uv run --no-project --with pytest --python 3.11 python -m pytest tests/test_mobile_form_validation.py tests/test_mobile_offline.py tests/test_mobile_vault.py tests/test_mobile_media_storage.py tests/test_mobile_api.py tests/test_gateway_auth.py -q
python.audit_spool: Private temporary directory with mode 0700; no candidate Gateway or database writes

environment_notes: The host Python lacked pytest; the authorized isolated uv environment supplied pytest without changing repository dependency files.
The first Python attempt used the default audit spool path, which the sandbox could not create; write-path cases returned 503. The successful rerun used a private temporary spool path.
limits: These source-level checks do not replace real-device airplane-mode testing, a real OIDC provider, or live candidate-Gateway browser consent acceptance.
The browser fixture is not the candidate Gateway and creates no persistent application data; one synthetic encrypted queue record and device credential remain in the isolated browser test vault.
rollback: The mock server was stopped. No source, candidate database, or candidate Gateway writes were made. The isolated browser test vault retains one encrypted synthetic pending record and device credential; deleting/resetting the vault requires the application’s explicit confirmation action.

browser_consent_acceptance.fixture: Local-only synthetic API served retired field_note revision 1.1.0 with required consent, allowed synthetic device enrollment, and returned HTTP 403 for sync.
checks: The retired required-consent form loaded from the synthetic fixture. A 19-character participant reference entered with real keyboard input was blocked by native browser minlength validation (32 characters required) and was not queued.

A valid synthetic reviewer-issued participant reference was saved into the encrypted local queue. The sync fixture returned HTTP 403; the UI displayed Sync failed (403) and retained one pending record after retry.
The first automation-driven short-reference fill bypassed native browser validation and was removed from the local queue. The real-keyboard validation check supersedes that attempt.

fixture_request_observation.sync_response: HTTP 403 for all fixture sync attempts
fixture_request_observation.note: The fixture held requests in memory only; the count includes the initial automation-driven validation attempt and subsequent retries.

browser_consent_acceptance.state_after_check: The isolated browser test vault remains unlocked with one encrypted synthetic record pending and its synthetic device credential. The temporary mock server has been stopped.
browser_consent_acceptance.limits: This validates client form input and encrypted-queue retention against a local mock. It does not exercise the candidate Gateway, real participant consent withdrawal, OIDC, or OS airplane-mode/reconnect.
